capture_rule: Capture the complete primary open article and complete supplementary-information record for Kyriakou et al., Significant Quantum Effects in Hydrogen Activation, DOI 10.1021/nn500703k. Preserve every reported experimental H2 and D2 activation identity, alloy or surface identity, exposure condition, temperature identity, event or rate signature, isotope contrast, barrier signature, uncertainty, method, figure, table, caption, adverse or unresolved row, and every declared calculated-only record in source order. Do not select by agreement, isotope direction, magnitude, method, surface, temperature, completeness or interpretation. Do not fit, average, digitize an unreported value, infer a missing value or use any calculated record as an experimental measurement.
source_selection_boundary: The DOI-identified complete article and its complete linked supplement are fixed before either target-bearing full-text record opens, before executable-law registration, before candidate enumeration and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because it is a primary open experimental comparison of retained hydrogen and deuterium activation identities on the same declared material system, with explicit barrier and isotope signatures and retained experimental/computational provenance. No observed isotope effect, barrier, rate, trend or desired agreement selects the source, record or Fold law.
